header.note: Every string a user reads on the pages of the provider (architecture §5.7), and the words of what the application draws around them: the theme, the controls of the bar, the headings the pages of the account are arranged under and the line each of them is read by. It wires no type of authorization detail and so says none: the type of the lab is said in src/Lab/translations/, with the lab. ICU message format: {client} is the name of the client, {username} the name of the user.
